arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production raster sprite source for HARVEST THE NIGHT, a cozy farm that becomes a fortress against zombies at night. Primary request: A053 Scarecrow King boss identity master, west-facing side view in the game's three-quarter camera. Create one towering hostile scarecrow lord: burlap sack head with stitched jagged grin and dark hollow eyes, crown of twisted dry branches and corn husks, long tattered violet-black and dark-red coat with blue-black crow-feather shoulder trim, straw bursting from cuffs, collar and hem, long thin stick limbs with twig claws and two stilt-like legs. It must read as a dark crowned enemy, clearly different from a friendly porch scarecrow or plain straw decoy. No straw hat, no pole, no birds, no magic or glow. Input 1 is the approved game's pixel-art style reference. Input 2 is the Giant boss scale and palette reference only, never its shape. Input 3 is the farmer size reference only. Composition: isolated complete body, canvas 80x64, contact pivot (40,60), visible body about 38x48 with arms down; keep the lowest feet at the pivot, leave clear room above the crown for the later cast pose. Keep the visible silhouette 30-44 wide and 44-50 tall at native size. Pixel art with colored outline, restrained clusters and readable at 1x. Neutral warm daylight from upper left. True transparent background; no ground shadow. No labels, typography, watermark, UI, extra objects, duplicate limbs, glow, blur, gradients, speckle or 3D. Create this as a sprite master source, not a character portrait sheet.
